documents.title: College profile and contact
documents.text: The supplied homepage identifies the institution as Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT), Ananthapuramu. Use the official Contact Us page for current contact/address details.

documents.text: The supplied homepage menu lists CSE, CSE (AI & ML), CSE (AI & Data Science), ECE, EEE, MEC, CIV and H&S. documents.title: Scholarships
documents.text: Scholarships are listed in the supplied homepage's Admissions menu. The provided homepage snapshot does not include specific scholarship schemes, eligibility rules, deadlines or amounts. Check the official Scholarships page and verify eligibility for the relevant academic year.

documents.title: Placements listed in the 2024–25 homepage snapshot
documents.text: The supplied homepage snapshot lists 2024–25 placement figures for companies including TCS, CTS, Lumen Technologies, HCL and Infosys. It lists TCS 164 offers (including Prime, Digital and Ninja categories), CTS 85, HCL 16 and Infosys 21, among other entries. These are figures shown in the supplied snapshot, not a guarantee of future outcomes or a verified current-year report. Check the official Training & Placement Statistics page for the most recent report and methodology.

documents.title: Campus facilities and student life
documents.text: The supplied homepage menu and facilities section mention a library, transport, hostels, internet, cafeteria, labs, sports, a Computer Center, internships and student chapters/clubs. The homepage describes a library with print and digital resources; figures in the source refer to August 2018 and should be treated as historical rather than current. For specific hostel availability, bus routes, timings or facilities, check the linked official pages or contact the college.

documents.title: Examinations, academic regulations and results
documents.text: The supplied homepage navigation includes Notifications, Results, Academic Regulations, Academic Calendars, Recounting & Re-Evaluation Procedure, Previous Question Papers, annual examination reports and DigiLocker marks memos. The homepage snapshot does not contain live individual results; use SRIT's official site navigation for current exam information.

documents.title: Student clubs, chapters, events and workshops
documents.text: The supplied homepage lists student chapters and clubs such as IEEE, ISTE, CSI, ASCE, Toastmasters, NDLI Club, Programmers Club and Shutter Bugs, plus campus events. Event posts in the supplied HTML are snapshots and should not be treated as upcoming schedules. Check the official website for current events.

documents.title: Accreditation and institutional status
documents.text: The supplied homepage includes navigation links for affiliations and accreditations, NAAC, NBA, AICTE, APSCHE and JNTUA. An embedded social profile in the supplied HTML mentions historical milestones (NAAC A grade in 2017, NBA accreditation in 2018 and autonomous status in 2019 for 10 years). Treat these as historical claims from the snapshot and verify current status and program-specific accreditation on the institution's official regulatory pages.

documents.title: How to contact the college
documents.text: Phone shown in the supplied homepage: 91-951 561 1111. Email shown: hr@srit.ac.in. For current office contacts, full postal address, department contacts and directions, use the official Contact Us page.
